cmd: ethtool -C eth0 rx-usecs 4294967295 rx-usecs-irq 5 pkt-rate-high 200000 tx-frames-high 8 cqe-mode-rx off
desc: boundary: dev=eth0 arx=absent atx=absent rxu=4294967295 rxf=absent txu=absent txf=absent irq=rx-usecs-irq rate=pkt-rate-high lowhigh=tx-frames-high cqe=rxoff aggr=absent rxcqe=absent
